actions.reason: K7_C0001 has a substantive, interpretable biological identity: a coherent, strongly down-shifted metabolic phenotype with coordinated suppression of oxidative phosphorylation (NES -2.49) and related metabolic programs at FDR q=0.001 (ER:...rna_pathway_enrichment:set:fb2d94aafe). Its boundaries against the two decision-relevant neighbors are not merge-compatible: the K7_C0001-K7_C0004 pair shows a represented current boundary (ARI 0.758, within 0.431 > between 0.178) and the K7_C0001-K7_C0007 pair shows perfect structural agreement (ARI 1.0, within 0.584 > between 0.172), with the K7_C0001-K7_C0007 native geometries providing coherent moderate separation (CT 0.101, WSI 0.230, WXS 0.229) (ER:...structural_diagnostics:pair:64c8b42920, ER:...structural_diagnostics:pair:777a140693, ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:280660912c). Although set-scope membership representation is conflicting (CT/RNA/WSI negative, WXS strongly positive) (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:set:fb2d94aafe), the relevant neighboring boundaries are not weak or merge-compatible, so the candidate remains an independent discovery-stage unit.

K7_C0002_M_K7_C0003 has interpretable biology (up-shifted OXPHOS/metabolic program, NES 2.99, FDR q<=0.01) (ER:...rna_pathway_enrichment:set:b0859de98e), but its membership is broadly unsupported: all four native geometries give directionally consistent negative membership representation (CT -0.045, RNA -0.106, WSI -0.096, WXS -0.165; negative fractions 0.61-0.92) (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:set:b0859de98e). Its relevant neighboring boundaries are weak or merge-compatible: the K7_C0002_M_K7_C0003-K7_C0004 pair shows only weak/inconsistent native separation (WSI 0.034, WXS 0.024) with a partially represented boundary (ARI 0.657) and single-cluster-dominated union (candidate_k=1) (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:0e75853f92, ER:...structural_diagnostics:pair:0e75853f92), and the K7_C0002_M_K7_C0003-K7_C0005 pair shows only weak directionally positive separation with a single-cluster-dominated union (candidate_k=1) (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:6f13a17c34, ER:...structural_diagnostics:pair:6f13a17c34). With broadly unsupported membership, weak/merge-compatible boundaries, and no supported structural revision, the candidate lacks defensible discovery value.

K7_C0004 has interpretable biology (down-shifted immune/inflammatory phenotype, allograft rejection NES -2.13, FDR q=0.001) (ER:...rna_pathway_enrichment:set:885be6c162), but its membership is weak and conflicting: no modality shows more than weak positive separation and WXS shows strong negative separation (-0.316, negative fraction 0.778) (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:set:885be6c162). Its relevant neighboring boundaries are weak or merge-compatible: K7_C0004-K7_C0006 shows weak/partially conflicting native separation (CT 0.025, WXS 0.325 with negative fraction 0.387) (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:c2efb020ad), K7_C0004-K7_C0007 shows a partially represented boundary (ARI 0.630) with high normalized-cut cost (0.620) and single-cluster-dominated union (candidate_k=1) (ER:...structural_diagnostics:pair:280660912c), K7_C0001-K7_C0004 shows weak/conflicting native separation with high normalized-cut cost (0.596) and single-cluster-dominated union (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:64c8b42920, ER:...structural_diagnostics:pair:64c8b42920), and K7_C0002_M_K7_C0003-K7_C0004 shows weak/inconsistent separation with single-cluster-dominated union (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:0e75853f92, ER:...structural_diagnostics:pair:0e75853f92). With weak/conflicting membership, merge-compatible boundaries, and no supported structural revision, the candidate lacks defensible discovery value.
